items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: But later on I started playing Piku's chorus on the trumpet

ctx.x: to remember remember to remember remember to remember I've got to give him all the credit I can give him, because if I had to choose the most authentic New Orleans style trumpet player right now, it would be Sharky. However, when I was coming up, maybe I had my sights set higher than that. First thing, I knew Sharky couldn't play Louis Range. I knew that. So as good as Sharky was, I'd like to play better than Sharky if I'd have made it. Maybe I never did touch Sharky as far as it goes. But anyway, you hear a lot…
You know, while I'm talking about all these tunes I forgot one. Who featured T.O. Sand?
